displayName: PRT GTFS-Realtime vehicle positions (bus + light rail)
rateLimitNote: Public, keyless GTFS-Realtime feed; PRT publishes no quota. The app pulls at most once per 15 s and serves cached rows to all clients in between.
notes: Official PRT feed. Gives position, bearing, speed, trip and route for each in-service vehicle. Vehicles without a trip are deadheading or parked.

rateLimitNote: Public, keyless; about 1.5 MB per pull, so it is read on demand (vehicle or stop selected) rather than polled.
notes: Predicted arrival/departure time for every remaining stop of each active trip.

rateLimitNote: Public, keyless; pulled at most every 2 minutes.
notes: Detours, stop closures, and elevator/escalator outages with affected routes and stops.

displayName: PRT static GTFS (routes, stops, schedules, shapes)
rateLimitNote: Public download (about 20 MB); PRT republishes it with each service change. Load daily at most.
notes: Loaded by TransitFeed.loadPrtNetwork into TransitRoute, TransitStop, TransitRoute.Trip, and TransitRoute.Path.

displayName: PRT TrueTime Bus Time API v3
rateLimitNote: Requires a free developer key from PRT; default quota 10,000 requests per day per key.
notes: Optional. Adds per-stop predictions with countdown and delay flags and detour geometry. GTFS-Realtime already covers Phase 1 without it.

displayName: CMU TripShot live ride and vehicle status
rateLimitNote: Public rider endpoint behind cmu.tripshot.com (no key, no published quota). The app pulls at most once per 15 s.
notes: This is the endpoint TripShot's public rider web app uses, not a documented partner API. For production, request TripShot Open API credentials through CMU Transportation Services. No public TripShot service-alert endpoint exists, so shuttle alerts are not available.

rateLimitNote: Public rider endpoint, no key. Loaded on demand by TransitFeed.loadTripShotNetwork.
notes: Shuttle route names and colors. Stops and route geometry come from the vias of today's rides.

rateLimitNote: Free with attribution under the OSMF tile usage policy; no heavy or bulk use. A production deployment should move to a commercial tile provider or Google Maps tiles.
notes: Loaded directly by the browser. CARTO basemaps were evaluated but now return an API-key placeholder tile, so they are not used. Google Maps tiles need googleMapsApiKey.

rateLimitNote: Free public instance under a fair-use policy, no key, and it sheds load with HTTP 503 at times. The app retries once and still returns county addresses and stops when it fails. Heavy production use should self-host Photon or use Google Places Autocomplete.
notes: Address and place autocomplete biased to Pittsburgh. Nominatim was replaced because its usage policy forbids autocomplete.

rateLimitNote: Official public county ArcGIS service, no key; up to 1,000 records per query. Queried only when the search starts with a house number.
notes: Authoritative street addresses (house number + street) for the whole county, so typed addresses resolve even when OpenStreetMap lacks the house number.

rateLimitNote: Community server, fair use only (about 1 request per second, no bulk use).
notes: Walking legs (geometry and duration) for trip planning. When it fails, plans fall back to straight-line estimates that are labeled as estimates.

displayName: Google Maps Platform Routes API (walking, transit, traffic)
rateLimitNote: Billed per request after the monthly free credit; set quotas in Google Cloud Console.
notes: Walking, transit, and live-traffic travel times. Optional: the keyless OSRM router covers walking.

rateLimitNote: Free for non-commercial use, under 10,000 calls per day; no key.
notes: Temperature, snowfall, snow depth, and precipitation for snow and ice warnings.

rateLimitNote: Public, keyless; requires an identifying User-Agent. Rate limit is unpublished.
notes: Official winter storm, ice, and wind advisories for Allegheny County.

rateLimitNote: Free, keyless; up to 100 points per request.
notes: Elevation samples along walking paths to compute grade and flag steep hills.

rateLimitNote: Requires a developer key from 511PA; the developer agreement sets the limits.
notes: Official incidents, construction, and road closures. Without a key the app has no authoritative traffic-incident feed.

rateLimitNote: Public RSS, keyless; poll no more than every 15 minutes. Headlines only, so items are unverified reports.
notes: Keyword monitoring for closures, crashes, and severe weather in local news.

rateLimitNote: Requires a key; the free developer plan is 100 requests per day and not licensed for production.
notes: Optional richer news search. Broadcast traffic radio (KDKA, KQV) publishes no public API, so radio reports are not integrated.
